limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The explicit angular inequality is proved on the one-positive/one-negative sign chamber; the global near-minimizer statement requires the finite threshold rho_n and does not claim that threshold optimal. No dimension-free global stability modulus for arbitrary deficit or higher-order classification beyond the Hessian is claimed. The sharp minimum theorem is recent, so differently phrased or not-yet-indexed parallel observations remain a residual originality risk.
record_title: Quantitative stability and exact Hessian for minimal central simplex sections
